name: Kimi Observability
description: OpenTelemetry-based observability for Kimi CLI with semantic conventions for AI agents (Ant Spec v2.0)

enableTelemetry.label: Enable Telemetry (Master Switch)
enableTelemetry.help: Must be enabled for any telemetry data collection. Env: KIMI_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=1

ant.label: Ant Identity Configuration
ant.help: User identity and agent metadata. Can also be set via AIVISION_ANT_USERNAME, AIVISION_AGENT_TYPE, etc.

log.label: Content Logging Controls
log.help: Fine-grained control over what content is recorded in spans and events. All default to off for privacy.

otelExporter.label: OTel Exporter Configuration
otelExporter.help: Base OTLP protocol configuration. Per-signal endpoints are configured in tracesConfig/metricsConfig/logsConfig/statusConfig.

tracesConfig.label: Traces Configuration
tracesConfig.help: Trace export endpoint and headers. Env: KIMI_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT, KIMI_OTLP_HEADERS

metricsConfig.label: Metrics Configuration
metricsConfig.help: Business metrics export endpoint and headers (e.g. agent.tool_call.count). Env: KIMI_OTLP_METRICS_ENDPOINT

logsConfig.label: Logs/Events Configuration
logsConfig.help: Events/logs export endpoint and headers. Env: KIMI_OTLP_LOGS_ENDPOINT

statusConfig.label: Status Metrics Configuration
statusConfig.help: Status/heartbeat metrics endpoint (e.g. aivision.agentic.up). Env: KIMI_OTLP_STATUS_ENDPOINT

enableTelemetry.description: Enable telemetry collection (master switch). Env: KIMI_ENABLE_TELEMETRY

log.description: Content logging controls with independent event/span configuration. Top-level shorthand (e.g. log.userPrompts) applies to both unless overridden.

userPrompts.description: [Shorthand] Record user prompt text in both events and spans. Env: KIMI_LOG_USER_PROMPTS

modelOutputs.description: [Shorthand] Record model output text in both events and spans. Env: KIMI_LOG_MODEL_OUTPUTS

toolDetails.description: [Shorthand] Record tool call parameters in both events and spans. Env: KIMI_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS

toolOutputs.description: [Shorthand] Record tool execution result text in both events and spans. Env: KIMI_LOG_TOOL_OUTPUTS

events.description: Content logging controls for OTel event bodies. Overrides top-level shorthand.

userPrompts.description: Record user prompt text in events. Env: KIMI_LOG_EVENTS_USER_PROMPTS

modelOutputs.description: Record model output text in events. Env: KIMI_LOG_EVENTS_MODEL_OUTPUTS

toolDetails.description: Record tool call parameters in events. Env: KIMI_LOG_EVENTS_TOOL_DETAILS

toolOutputs.description: Record tool execution result text in events. Env: KIMI_LOG_EVENTS_TOOL_OUTPUTS

spans.description: Content logging controls for span attributes. Overrides top-level shorthand.

userPrompts.description: Record user prompt text in span attributes. Env: KIMI_LOG_SPANS_USER_PROMPTS

modelOutputs.description: Record model output text in span attributes. Env: KIMI_LOG_SPANS_MODEL_OUTPUTS

toolDetails.description: Record tool call parameters in span attributes. Env: KIMI_LOG_SPANS_TOOL_DETAILS

toolOutputs.description: Record tool execution result text in span attributes. Env: KIMI_LOG_SPANS_TOOL_OUTPUTS

endpoint.description: OTLP traces endpoint URL. Env: KIMI_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT

headers.description: Custom headers for traces export. Env: KIMI_OTLP_HEADERS (JSON)

endpoint.description: OTLP metrics endpoint URL. Env: KIMI_OTLP_METRICS_ENDPOINT

headers.description: Custom headers for metrics export. Env: KIMI_OTLP_METRICS_HEADERS (JSON)

endpoint.description: OTLP logs endpoint URL. Env: KIMI_OTLP_LOGS_ENDPOINT

headers.description: Custom headers for events/logs export. Env: KIMI_OTLP_LOGS_HEADERS (JSON)

endpoint.description: OTLP status metrics endpoint URL. Env: KIMI_OTLP_STATUS_ENDPOINT

headers.description: Custom headers for status metrics export. Env: KIMI_OTLP_STATUS_HEADERS (JSON)

debug.description: Enable debug dual-write mode (stderr + file + auto replay). Env: KIMI_DEBUG
